verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a first-party hosted MCP server that lets users operate their account in natural language through an AI agent instead of the dashboard or API calls. It covers pricing, failed-payment investigation, refunds, subscription changes and reports, with a codemode interface spanning the full API. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (it relies on an external agent client such as Claude or Cursor), and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Instead of navigating the dashboard or making API calls, you can ask an agent in natural language to handle pricing, billing, support, and integration workflows.
Build pricing models, investigate failed payments, integrate Paddle features, or process customer refunds — all in natural language.
Lets AI agents read data and take actions in your Paddle account.
